title.en: Verify signed documents against key records: ok, tampered, revoked, unknown, unsigned

goal.en: A signature is checked against a list of KeyRecords. The conformance vectors carry a valid signature, a tampered document, a revoked key and an unknown key; an unsigned document gives its own reason.

note.en: A recall signed with a key whose record is valid: ok.
The same document with one field changed: bad_signature.
Signed after the key was revoked: key_revoked.
A key id that no record matches: unknown_key.
The example incident report carries no signature at all: unsigned.

outcome.en: You can tell the five answers apart and know that only ok means a document may be trusted. Next: scenario 059 reads an execution log the way an insurer would.
